title: The King's Strongroom puzzle (opening the strongbox) offers only might ('force it') or grace ('pick it') checks, with no will/persuasion option, even though the steward's shade guarding it literally monologues about words vs. iron ('a man's word once needed iron behind it to be believed') and virtually every other obstacle in the game up to this point had offered a will-based path for a talker build.
